judgments.rationale: The proposed summary requires 'execution by the debtor of a written agreement with the agency head to repay the claim' before administrative offset can occur. This directly contradicts paragraph (4), which requires only giving the debtor 'an opportunity to make a written agreement', not actual execution of one. Requiring execution would preclude offset whenever a debtor refuses to sign an agreement.

The proposed summary appends argumentative meta-commentary ('The last prerequisite is the opportunity to make an agreement, not the execution of one.') that does not represent statutory content. Furthermore, the four prerequisite conditions are already separately captured by claim C0001, making their insertion into the summary of C0000 (whose quote ends at F000) a duplicate and structurally mismatched qualification.
